name: librejustice
description: Free and open source, LibreJustice gives your agent ~3.7 million French and European decisions and ~3.6 million legal articles as they stood on any date: five MCP tools over OAuth, no API key, and two research skills.

interface.longDescription: The only legal research connector your agent needs for French law: ~3.7 million decisions from France's administrative and judicial courts and European courts, linked article by article to ~3.6 million legal articles as they stood on any date, plus EU law, treaties, collective agreements, and codes from 59 countries.
defaultPrompt: Trouve la jurisprudence sur la rupture brutale d'une relation commerciale établie et cite tes sources.
Quel était le texte de l'article L. 313-11 du CESEDA en vigueur en 2019 ?
Quels textes s'appliquent à un contrat conclu en 2015 ? Donne les versions en vigueur à cette date.
